models.mechanism: Recurring time becomes a production-and-settlement cycle. Under its press the generic human account defaults to trade loss and short measure; the exception assembles a cooperative institution in which trust secures custody, labor and transactions produce return, settlement repairs disputes, reciprocal charges link participants, truth fixes due claims, and patience supplies surety. The packet supplies those roles; I infer that their coordination converts the same temporal pressure from depletion into extracted yield.

structural_cues: The oath and general loss statement are followed by إِلَّا, so the exception changes the outcome under the same invoked time rather than removing time.
The exception is plural and contains four coordinated predicates, shifting the unit from generic humanity to an organized group.
تَوَاصَوْا is reciprocal and repeated with two بِـ complements, making mutual linkage rather than solitary possession structurally decisive.

abductive_moves.assumption: The exception's terms form an institutional workflow rather than an unconnected list.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: Trust, pay, transactions, settlement, linked charges, due claims, and surety converge lexically, but the verse does not name a cooperative or contract system.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies trust + work/transaction + settlement + reciprocal charge + right + surety; I infer coordinated safeguards → reduced short-measure and dispute → preserved capital and yield.
alternatives: The predicates may describe individual moral qualities without an economic institution.
Their conjunction may indicate co-presence without functional sequence.

abductive_moves.assumption: The oath's recurring time is the production or settlement cycle that tests this institution.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The oath grammatically witnesses the loss/exception contrast but does not explicitly cause, audit, or settle it.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies recurring time, press, loss, exception, and yield; I infer temporal pressure → balance revealed, with institutional structure determining loss versus yield.
alternatives: Time may be only a witness.
Yield and trade branches of ع ص ر and خ س ر may remain inactive.

changed_reading.before: At stage 1, time was an audit-like press exposing an isolated human account as deficient.
changed_reading.after: Time is the recurring pressure of production and settlement; a reciprocal trust-work-rights-surety institution changes what that pressure extracts from loss into yield.

models.ablation: Remove the doubled reciprocal وَتَوَاصَوْا or و ص ي/B002–B003 and the model collapses from a cooperative institution into individual good conduct; remove خ س ر/B002–B003 and the ledger problem disappears; remove ع ص ر/B002 and B007 and the focus becomes generic time rather than a pressure-to-yield cycle.

models.mechanism: The newly revealed roots also assemble a material pastoral cycle: a recurring season stacks cloud, squeezes it into rain, makes pasture fit grazing stock, brings animals to full condition, and yields reliable work animals and gain instead of trade loss. This causal order is my reconstruction; the packet supplies each material stage but does not state a weather or livestock narrative.

structural_cues: إِلَّا marks the entire newly revealed root-set as outcome-changing relative to loss.
The long conjunction chain packages the factors as co-present, while its surface order does not itself assert the ecological order reconstructed here.
The two reciprocal تَوَاصَوْا forms support interdependence, though assigning that reciprocity to an ecological feedback loop is abductive.

abductive_moves.assumption: The unusually convergent cloud, rain, pasture, livestock, fitness, work-animal, and yield branches are jointly active.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: These material images occur in independent roots of the newly revealed ayah and complete a continuous production chain, but their surface words ordinarily retain their stated sentence roles.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies layered cloud + rain + favorable pasture + full animal condition + work fitness + yield; I infer cloud → rain → forage → mature reliable stock → productive gain.
alternatives: The material branches may be coincidental dormant senses.
The ayah may activate only the social and ethical branches.

abductive_moves.assumption: The exception contrasts a functioning seasonal economy with the trade-loss state.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet states an exception to loss but does not say that rainfall or livestock productivity causes it.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies exception, trade loss, and the material chain; I infer completed seasonal chain → adequate return → escape from trade loss.
alternatives: The exception may have no material-economic realization.

changed_reading.before: Stage 1 offered no seasonal material model; time was an audit or a confining interval.
changed_reading.after: The oath can invoke the productive season itself: layered cloud is pressed into rain and carried through pasture and mature work-stock into yield.

models.ablation: Remove ص ب ر/B010 or ع ص ر/B003 and the cloud-to-rain engine vanishes; remove و ص ي/B004 or ح ق ق/B013 and rain no longer bridges to livestock yield, leaving only a generic weather metaphor; remove خ س ر/B002 and إِلَّا and the cycle no longer changes the focus from loss toward gain.

surprise_reading: On the full packet, “By al-ʿaṣr” can name a recurring production-and-settlement pressure: humanity defaults to a losing account, while a trust-based cooperative of work, settlement, reciprocal obligation, rights, and surety converts pressure into yield. More radically, the new roots assemble a pastoral season—layered cloud, squeezed rain, favorable pasture, mature reliable work-stock, and gain—so the oath invokes a whole productive weather-cycle rather than duration alone.
discarded_or_unchanged: The stage-1 static temporal_shelter model is discarded: the 103:3 exception makes confinement non-universal, while its refuge/attachment potential is better absorbed into the reciprocal cooperative mechanism.
